predictions.articleTitle: Kryvbas KR vs Kudrivka Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Petrakov's Rebuild Tests Leaky Defense
predictions.coreRecommendation: Kryvbas KR's home organization under Oleksandr Petrakov and Kudrivka's 2.42 goals-conceded-per-game defensive vulnerability support a Home Win / Draw projection led by a narrow 2:1 home victory.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 Direction: Home Win / Draw led by Kryvbas KR victory at Hirnyk Stadium against Kudrivka's porous road defense (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Total Goals & BTTS Direction: Over 2.5 Goals and Both Teams To Score (Yes), driven by 2.91 combined lambda expectancy and 72.7%-80.0% single-side scoring projections (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Stalemate Contingency: 1:1 Draw if Kryvbas KR's 0.80 goals-per-game attack misfires without Shakeone Satchwell against a compact Kudrivka block (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Petrakov's tightened Kryvbas host Kudrivka's 2.42 goals-conceded-per-game defense.

spf.comment: Covers both a 2:1 Kryvbas KR breakthrough against Kudrivka's 2.42 goals-conceded-per-game defense and a 1:1 stalemate if Kryvbas KR's 0.80 goals-per-game attack stalls, whereas a single call would ignore their four league draws.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.91 combined lambda expectancy (55.6% Poisson Over 2.5) and Kudrivka conceding 15 goals across four verified away league defeats.

btts.comment: Both defenses concede frequently (1.60 and 2.42 goals per game), yielding a 58.2% Poisson BTTS Yes baseline with 80.0% home and 72.7% away scoring probabilities.

score.comment: Converges on the top two Poisson-aligned outcomes (9.2% and 11.4%), capturing Kryvbas KR's home edge alongside their 0.80 goals-per-game finishing ceiling.

goals.comment: Captures the 2-to-3-goal Poisson ridge (22.4% and 23.1% density) matching the 2:1 primary victory and 1:1 stalemate branch.

bqc.comment: Reflects a cautious, level first half under Petrakov before the second half splits between a late Kryvbas KR breakthrough or a shared-points stalemate.
